dimension.description: Specific seeded or emergent behavioral dimension (e.g. epistemic.abstraction_depth, dialectic.plan_before_code, emergent.tdd_loop).

habit_reflection.description: Whether the owner confirmed this observed habit as their desired behavior (observed_keep) or intentionally inverted/tuned it toward an aspirational habit (aspirational_shift).

portable_rule.description: Actionable instruction containing zero company-specific or repo-specific proper nouns.

portability_check.description: Why this trait holds across any company, domain, or repository.

peer_fork.description: What another strong, reasonable engineer might legitimately prefer instead (proves this is a personal trait, not baseline agent competence).

flips_when.description: Explicit boundary condition where the user intentionally suspends or inverts this rule.

workspace_bindings.description: Optional mapping of workspace/company names to how this portable rule binds in that environment (kept separate from portable_rule).

eval_matcher.description: Optional regular expression used by `imprint eval` to test whether held-out session interventions match this claim.
